title: BashQueues cron is application scheduling authority
summary: Systemd supervises long-running services and wakes the existing BashQueues cron ticker every minute. The ticker submits governed jobs; workers, not cron or timer units, perform scheduled maintenance.
invariants: No system crond or application crontab dependency.
systemd minute timer is an allowed ticker wakeup, not an independent business scheduler.
Backups, audits, certificate renewal workflows and housekeeping run as policy-admitted BashQueues job classes.
Deduplicate minute firings and prevent concurrency, prove authorisation denial and reboot recovery.
Private CA issuance must not silently downgrade to ACME/public CA.

provenance.claim: Schedules use owned BashQueues with systemd minute ticker.
